text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph development with repeated examples and reasoning","quality":"development","description":"The essay sustains and expands its main idea with supporting points instead of giving only brief assertions."},{"evidence":"conditional and concessive phrasing like \"Although some traits...\" and \"Even though tragic experiences...\"","quality":"reasoning complexity","description":"The essay shows more layered thinking by qualifying claims and acknowledging counterarguments."},{"evidence":"topic sentences and a concluding paragraph","quality":"organization","description":"The essay is more clearly structured into an introduction, body development, and conclusion."},{"evidence":"transitions such as \"Although,\" \"Even though,\" and \"In conclusion\"","quality":"cohesive linking","description":"The essay uses more explicit connectors to guide the reader through its ideas."},{"evidence":"more varied vocabulary like \"trustworthy,\" \"consequences,\" \"influences,\" and \"personality\"","quality":"lexical range","description":"The essay uses a broader and more precise set of words to express its points."},{"evidence":"longer, more elaborated sentences with embedded clauses","quality":"sentence complexity","description":"The essay more often builds ideas into longer syntactic structures rather than relying on short simple statements."}]}
